description: This file defines a dataclass 'Settings' for application configuration, loading environment variables for database, authentication, and JWT settings. It includes functions to require environment variables and to get integer environment variables with defaults, along with a function to load the complete settings object.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable dataclass holding configuration variables loaded from environment variables.

methods.name: str _require_env(name: str)
methods.description: Fetches an environment variable, raising an error if it's missing or empty.

methods.name: int _get_int(name: str, default: int)
methods.description: Fetches an environment variable and converts it to an integer, returns a default if unset, raises an error if conversion fails.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Main function to load and validate all required environment variables into a Settings instance.
